Text recognition models for business cards (run on the device, offline).

det.onnx    PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 small text detection model (ONNX), Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE.txt)
rec.onnx    PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 small text recognition model (ONNX), Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE.txt)
keys.json   The recognition model's character list, taken from its inference.yml

Copyright (c) PaddlePaddle Authors. Unchanged from the official ONNX releases.
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
